2608.07454.title: Strategy-first synthesis planning for complex natural products
2608.07454.paper_summary: The total synthesis of a complex molecule is among the most demanding intellectual and experimental feats in chemistry: a chemist must plan many steps ahead for how to assemble simple building blocks into an intricate target, devise backup strategies, and anticipate procedural challenges. It is also a profoundly creative activity. For half a century, efforts to automate the retrosynthetic design of natural products and other complex molecules have drawn on catalogued reactions, and the resulting tools now report near-complete success on benchmarks built from that same source. But these tools were shaped to fit benchmarked chemistry, and they falter on many natural products, the frontier of the field, whose densely functionalized, polycyclic architectures demand precisely the inventive chemistry the record contains least. Whether a machine could reasonably design such syntheses like an expert chemist does has remained unclear. Here, we show that SynthEx, an agentic framework built on large language models, plans routes to complex natural products that lie beyond the reach of conventional design algorithms. SynthEx proposes competing strategies, assembles a sequence of routine and key steps into a cohesive route, and critiques and improves its own design; the chemistry it favours is more convergent than existing tools produce, and spans a region of reaction space that catalogue-based tools cannot match. Most notably, in blinded assessments, expert chemists judged its key steps comparable to those of published human syntheses and engaged with them as genuine synthesis plans, a response algorithmic route prediction has not previously accomplished. We release routes to more than a thousand natural products as SynthAtlas, an open, interactive database, and anticipate it will become a shared resource for a collection of complex target molecules that lack existing literature routes.
2608.07454.paper_summary_zh: 複雜分子的總合成是化學中最具挑戰性的智力和實驗成就之一：化學家必須提前計劃許多步驟，以便將簡單的構建塊組裝成錯綜複雜的目標，設計備用策略，並預見程序挑戰。這也是一項深具創造性的活動。在過去的半個世紀裡，自然產物和其他複雜分子的逆合成設計自動化的努力依賴於已編目反應，結果工具在基於相同來源構建的基準上報告了近乎完全的成功。但是這些工具是為了適應基準化學而設計的，對於許多自然產物，這個領域的前沿，其密集功能化的多環架構要求的正是記錄中最缺乏的創新化學，因此它們表現不佳。機器是否能像專家化學家一樣合理地設計這樣的合成仍然不明確。在這裡，我們展示了SynthEx，一個基於大型語言模型的主動框架，能夠規劃通往超越傳統設計算法範疇的複雜自然產品的路徑。SynthEx 提出競爭策略，將一系列常規和關鍵步驟組合成一個連貫的路徑，並批評和改進自己的設計；它所偏好的化學比現有工具產生的更具收斂性，並涵蓋了一個編目工具無法匹配的反應空間區域。最值得注意的是，在盲測評估中，專家化學家認為其關鍵步驟與已發表的人類合成相當，並將其視為真正的合成計劃，這是算法路徑預測之前未曾實現的反應。我們發布了超過一千種自然產品的路徑，作為SynthAtlas，一個開放的互動數據庫，並預期它將成為一個共享資源，供缺乏現有文獻路徑的複雜目標分子使用。
